Weight Change & Progress Calculator

Compare two weigh-ins to see how much your weight changed, how fast on average, and how far you are from an optional goal.

Educational estimates only. Results are not medical advice, a diagnosis, or a treatment plan. Talk to a qualified healthcare professional about your health. Read the full medical disclaimer.

How to use this calculator

  1. Choose your weight unit.
  2. Enter starting and current weight, and a goal if you have one.
  3. Choose the two dates and press Calculate.

The formulas

Change = current − starting weight. Percentage change = change ÷ starting weight × 100. Average per week = change ÷ (days ÷ 7). Dates must be valid and in order.

Keep it in perspective

Body weight moves up and down day to day with fluid, food and more. This tool describes the past and does not predict future weight or promise any timeline. Gradual, sustainable habits matter more than speed, and a healthcare professional can help if you want support.

Want more detail? Read the guide: How to track weight and body measurements consistently.

Frequently asked questions

Does this predict when I will reach my goal?

No. It only reports what already happened and the gap to your goal. Future change varies too much to predict.

Why is the weekly average blank?

It needs at least one day between the dates. Very short periods are also unreliable because daily fluctuations are large.

Is a fast change a good sign?

Not necessarily. Rapid change can be unhealthy. Please talk to a doctor or other qualified healthcare professional about your own situation.

Are my numbers saved?

No. This calculator keeps nothing. Use the Body Measurement Tracker if you want records stored in your browser.
